title: Votorantim sells Argentine steelmaker to Mexican group
dek: Votorantim has sold an Argentine steelmaker to a Mexican group, according to Latin Lawyer.
summary: Latin Lawyer reports that Votorantim has sold an Argentine steelmaker to a Mexican group. The headline does not name the steelmaker or the buyer, nor give deal terms.
keyFacts: Votorantim sold an Argentine steelmaker to a Mexican group
whyItMatters: The deal points to continued ownership reshuffling in Latin American steel.
implications: Regional competitors and customers in Argentina may watch the new owner's strategy. Deal value is not disclosed in the material.
